paper_title: ToolFactory Automating Tool Generation by Leveraging LLM to Understand   REST API Documentations
caption: Training loss of APILLAMA. We applied moving average of window size 5 to smooth the training curve. Validation result is produced in every 20 steps.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training and validation loss per batch over training steps. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140 with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 2.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A blue line represents the smoothed training loss per batch, starting at a value of approximately 2.3 at step 0, decreasing to approximately 0.6 at step 20, then exhibiting further fluctuations down to approximately 0.2 at step 40, followed by a relatively stable range between 0.2 and 0.7 from step 60 to step 140, ending at a value of approximately 0.6. An orange line represents the validation loss, beginning at approximately 1.4 at step 0, decreasing to approximately 0.4 at step 40, and subsequently maintaining a relatively constant level between 0.3 and 0.5 from step 40 to step 140, concluding at approximately 0.4.
